test_mention_stripped_command_dispatch: test the discord adapter strips @mention from messages and dispatches slash commands
test_auto_threading_preserves_command: test that slash commands are still dispatched after auto-threading creates a thread
test_nickname_mention_then_command: test that nickname-style mentions like <@!BOT> are stripped and slash commands are dispatched
test_dm_no_mention_needed: test that DM messages do not require @mention to dispatch slash commands
test_no_mention_in_channel_dropped: test that channel messages without @mention are silently dropped
